_doc: Statistics-only confidence of the hockey / basketball / volleyball / CS2 coupon legs, fitted by scripts/sofa/fit_sport_confidence.py. A leg's confidence is the realised_lo95 of the bucket its model probability (score_model / cs2_engine) falls in, for an ADMITTED key (family|OVER/UNDER/DRAW/TEAM) only; a key in not_calibrated, a bucket absent from the curve (n < min_bucket) or a sport absent from this file is NOT_CALIBRATED. No price is an input.

fitted_from.staged: fit_sport_confidence.py --sport <s> --before 2026-10-07 --dry-run --rows-out (2026-10-07), sections assembled; EXTENDED_MARKETS scored from the history; cs2 and volleyball refitted with CS2_EXTENDED_FAMILIES / volleyball EXTENDED_MARKETS; cs2 refitted ~11:35Z with the series families (cs2_engine.SERIES_KAPPA); rows kept in data/line_evidence/rows_before_2026-10-07
fitted_from.basketball_bb_freshness: basketball section refitted 2026-10-07 with --bb-freshness on (SimParams.bb_fresh_mult in the replay), --before 2026-10-08; other sports unchanged
